description.value: Langley Farm Market is a Metro Vancouver chain specializing in freshly picked local produce, working directly with BC farms to stock everything from Okanagan fruit to organic Metro Vancouver vegetables. The Richmond location sits inside Lansdowne Centre and also carries natural and organic groceries, in-store baked goods, fresh meat, deli cold cuts, and chilled seafood. It won the 2025 Vancouver Consumer Choice Award for Best Fruit & Vegetable Market, making it a well-regarded stop for cyclists seeking quality fresh food.
